plainLanguage: Section 79 — Rioting after proclamation — ni sehemu ya mfumo wa Chapter IX unaohusu unlawful assemblies, riots na public tranquility.
meaning: It criminalises taking or continuing to take part after the expiry of a reasonable time following a proclamation to disperse.
keyPoints: A proclamation to disperse must have been made.
Continued participation is punishable by five years' imprisonment.

history.summary: Section 79 appears in Chapter IX of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Text verified against the R.E. 2022 government-hosted Penal Code.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each statutory threshold and sequence should be proved from evidence.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Requirements such as reasonable time, authorised actors and reasonable necessity materially limit the provision's operation.

debateQuestion: Je, statutory conditions zote za section 79 zimetimizwa kwa facts husika?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
